question: When the hold list is made again on a full pass.

addresses.name: CAIUnit::RebuildHoldProvinces
addresses.comment: **Slot 80**, 0x4B3A50 to the bare `ret` at 0x4B41F0. CAIUnit::Tick calls it through [vftable+0x140] at 0x4B0A99 (Ghidra's `vf_80`) - so the tick's two calls after slot 78 are slot 79 ManageExpeditions at 0x4B0A36 and slot 80 this. It clears the CList at +0x17C and refills it, kept in descending score order (CList_InsertByDescendingScore) with 0x1C-byte records {province, 0, score}: (1) every objective of the agent's unit's plan (CUnit +0x234) whose province's controller is on our side (IsSameSide) or a co-belligerent that is not an enemy, scored 0x4B4200(this, province) **plus the objective's priority (CObjective +0xC, read at 0x4B3C64)**; (2) every focus province of the owner AI (CEU3AI +0x118) that we control, or whose controller we are not at war with (neither REB, and no undeclared war covering it), scored 0x4B4200 plus 200.0; then sets +0x82. For a theatre agent (or no unit) of a country that is not a subject: the provinces of each focus owner area (+0x338) belonging to a puppet of ours where none of that puppet's land units stands or is heading, and the provinces of the theatre's +0x60 list, each kept when 0x4B4200 reaches 0.1, the score rounded to a whole number. Last, the list is cut from the tail to max(land units +0x11C minus non-division units +0x14C, the objective and focus count). Read by slot 86 (0x4C7CA7). The name is ours and only the shape is read; 0x4B4200's score is not. **On the listing, 2026-11-10: a subject (CCountry +0xF34) skips only the puppets' focus areas, and goes on to the theatre's +0x60 provinces.** The set the objectives and focus provinces went into is asked of the puppets' and the theatre's provinces and not added to, so a province in both comes twice. The score is rounded by fistp, so a half to the even. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 15. **Read live 2026-11-11** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 48): the list is a CList - head +0x17C, tail +0x180, count +0x184, nodes {record, prev, next} - of records {province, 0, score (float), 0, flag, flag}; the two flags were 0 for a province the country holds and another owns (10004) and for a foreign one (Yemen's 9768), 1 for the rest. Britain's East Africa Command entering July 1941 held 8, Yemen's 9768 among them at 33. **The puppet arm is per province** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 52, on the listing 2026-11-11): over each puppet focus area's provinces, one where a land unit of the puppet stands (+0x130) or whose path ends (+0x13C) is skipped, the rest scored - not the area skipped as a whole. **When, confirmed on the running game 2026-11-13** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 68): besides +0x82 clear and +0x1E4 > 0, on a full pass where Date_DayOfMonth(tick) % 7 == 0 (0x4B0A71-0x4B0A84), the day counted from nought - the 1st, 8th, 15th, 22nd and 29th. Britain's East Africa Command made its list again at 09:00 on 1 January with +0x82 set, taking in a fifth division.
